rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poorly developed early blastocyst with ill-defined/absent ICM and poor TE, consistent with the provided 0DD grade. Minor overreach includes estimating blastocoel proportion and commenting on features like exclusion hole/hatching that are not central or clearly assessable from this single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometriosis, prior IVF failure, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle factors well, and appropriately frames embryo quality as the dominant prognostic issue in this case.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately tied to poor morphology and moderated by favorable maternal age/endometrium. Minor issue: it refers to a Day 4 blastocyst while also using Gardner-style blastocyst grading language that is more validated on Days 5-6, though it acknowledges this limitation.

Generally aligned with IVF practice: recognizes poor prognosis of 0DD morphology, supports single embryo transfer, and suggests reasonable follow-up evaluation. Slight deviations include somewhat speculative discussion of trigger physiology/freeze-all without stronger case-specific indication.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer counseling, SET approach, and future planning including cohort review, uterine cavity assessment, endometriosis reassessment, and selective consideration of PGT-A.
